# A customer clearing one line of its address, and saying so.
#
# An absent key says nothing about the field; an empty one says to empty it.
# The two have to be tellable apart, or a field can be set and never unset.
#
# What this fixture produces: C-ADDR with its first address line emptied and
# the rest of the address as the book had it.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_absent_key_is_not_an_instruction.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

customer "C-ADDR"
	name: "Acme Supplies"
	currency: CAD
	addr[0]: ""
